source.repro: node plugins/linear-comparative-view/benches/offscreenMateOverlay.bench.ts --rounds=25 — min of rounds, two samples, control 0.97-1.01. Node rather than jest: this is a Float64Array read in a loop, the shape BENCHMARKING.md measures jest inflating 6-30x (it read the 250k repaint as 84ms).
source.notes: 1500px band, 100px tall. demo-2767 is peach chr1 over grape chr1 in demos/grape_peach_cacao — 2767 dropped anchors across 9 grape contigs. The stress rows are the query-whole-genome/target-one-contig state, which is what makes the stub count unbounded: nothing caps the fetch, and minAlignmentLength is applied at draw time. `hover, before` is the pre-2026-08-19 hit test, which laid out every stub before testing the pointer's y. The repaint column is LAYOUT and path building; the fake context's fill is a no-op, so rasterization is not in it. The SVG export layer column is what a figure carries: the strip serializes as one path element, a fifth of what a rect per alignment cost.
